purpose: Backend-neutral observable contract for A-memory implementations and simulators that store and execute an A-network of Links against the accepted MTS v0.14 foundation while keeping the independently pinned execution profile explicit.

backendDeclaration.profileSupportRule: A backend may declare the pinned profile while supportLevel remains partial; full profile conformance requires executable evidence for every mandatory portable execution law and may not be inferred from storage-only witnesses.

requirements.statement: An A-memory implementation MUST both store an A-network of Links and execute that network according to the declared MTS semantics; storage-only or execution-only components are substrates/components, not complete A-memory implementations.
Every backend MUST declare the exact accepted MTS foundation revision and exact normative contract/conformance revision, independently from the exact A-memory execution-profile pin.
Portable semantic identity MUST be structural; backend-local handles, addresses, indices and allocation order MUST NOT cross implementation boundaries as semantic identity.

Portable interchange and differential observations MUST use a declared structural representation appropriate to the semantic value: arbitrary recursive Link structure/wire MUST NOT be mislabeled as Anum/ExactSequence, while verified sequence values MAY use the accepted Anum representation.

Observable Link behavior MUST preserve accepted structural classification and topology while semantic START_K/END_K roles are derived context-relatively from Link-native orientation; raw carrier start/end coordinates MUST NOT become semantic orientation authority.
Description, transport representation, cache entry or speculative candidate MUST NOT by itself grant authority to materialize a semantic target.
Within the declared execution scope, A-memory MUST reproduce accepted grounded reaction behavior including ZERO/ONE/MANY continuations.

A conformant full A-memory backend MUST expose a persistent/logically persistent A-network state across execution steps; execution MUST operate on that network rather than on a detached host-only semantic model.

Execution semantics MUST be driven by the A-network/Theory structures admitted by the declared MTS scope; backend-specific opcodes or hard-coded program meaning MUST NOT replace Link-carried semantic authority.
Duplicate physical candidate production MUST converge to the same semantic Link result under canonical identity.
Theory/context isolation and fail-closed boundaries MUST be preserved; unauthorized relations MUST NOT affect the reaction.
Physical scheduling, storage layout and accelerator execution MAY differ but MUST NOT silently redefine observable semantics inside a claimed conformant scope.
Backends conformant to the same exact MTS revision MUST agree under normalized portable observations for their shared declared scope.
Performance and hardware efficiency are non-semantic properties and MUST NOT weaken conformance requirements.
No A-memory backend is normative authority for MTS; semantic changes discovered during implementation MUST return to anum_docs for theory-level acceptance.
Every accelerated operation in a claimed scope MUST have an executable differential witness against an independently executed reference backend or oracle.
A backend mismatch MUST fail closed; a divergent accelerator result MUST NOT be reported as conformant or successful for that operation.
Differential validation MUST include a negative control that deliberately perturbs a result and proves the checker detects the mismatch.
The actual execution backend path MUST be observable; CPU fallback MUST NOT be reported as accelerator/GPU execution.
Parallel candidate occurrences with equal pole pairs MUST converge to one canonical commit request for that pair.
Physical representative selection, accelerator lane id, occurrence index and allocation order MUST NOT become portable semantic Link identity.
Candidate canonicalization MUST complete before semantic materialization; candidate presence or duplicate convergence alone MUST NOT authorize semantic target creation.
CPU/reference and accelerator canonicalization implementations MUST agree on normalized pair-set observations for their shared declared scope.
A stateful backend MUST preserve committed A-memory storage state across declared execution/storage steps within its declared physical scope.
For pre-authorized canonical pair commits, successor storage MUST contain exactly the union of prior stored pairs and authorized commits within the backend's declared physical scope.
Repeated and duplicate authorized commits for the same pair MUST be idempotent in portable observation.
Physical storage coordinates, matrix cells, local handles and accelerator addresses MUST NOT become portable semantic Link identity.
The storage primitive MUST NOT infer MTS materialization authority; only explicitly pre-authorized requests may enter semantic storage through this boundary.
Reference CPU and accelerator state transitions MUST agree after every observed step in their shared declared scope.

Portable structural interchange for an arbitrary supported Link MUST use a canonical recursive Link structural representation/codec (or an explicitly equivalent declared representation) rather than backend-local handles; Anum is reserved for sequence semantics where applicable.
Importing the same canonical recursive Link wire into independently allocated Memories MUST reconstruct structurally equivalent Links despite different local handles.

Exporting a supported well-founded local Link through the direct structural codec MUST produce its canonical recursive Link wire; an ExactSequence/sequence value MAY additionally be represented as Anum only after the sequence boundary is verified.
Malformed, truncated, trailing-garbage, unsupported or capacity-exceeding recursive-Link-wire or sequence/Anum import MUST fail closed before partial semantic publication.

Local allocation order, local handle values and physical coordinates MUST NOT affect exported portable structural identity, whether observed as recursive Link wire or as a verified sequence/Anum representation.
Repeated import of the same structural Link inside one Memory MUST reuse canonical local Link identity independently of which accepted portable representation produced it.
Every backend MUST declare the exact implemented A-memory execution profile id, version and immutable upstream profile pin in addition to the accepted MTS foundation revision.

Every backend MUST declare how the current Scope is represented and atomically published; an unimplemented current-Scope mechanism MUST be stated explicitly rather than inferred from a host cursor or storage handle.
Every backend MUST declare whether prior physical Links and prior Scope structures are retained, reclaimed or compacted; this physical retention policy MUST NOT redefine current semantic membership.

Every backend MUST enumerate its substrate/layout and physical scheduling choices and MUST mark local handles, allocation order, thread order, work-group order, GPU-lane order and backend API shape as non-semantic.

Every backend claiming execution-profile support MUST define normalized semantic observation and executable differential evidence against an independently executed reference/backend for the shared declared scope.

Storage, incidence, canonicalization, persistence or Anum round-trip evidence MAY support profile invariants but MUST NOT be reported as full reaction-profile conformance until the required A-network reaction laws are executed and differentially verified.

A-memory execution semantics MUST be consumed from the pinned machine-readable execution profile and its canonical semantic owner; implementation control flow in anum_docs or amemory MUST NOT become an alternate semantic authority.

The accepted MTS v0.14 foundation pin and the independently pinned post-v0.13 A-memory execution-profile 0.1.0 pin MUST remain immutable and independently upgradable under explicit governance; the execution profile MUST NOT be relabeled as v0.14.

Any backend claiming an executable reaction slice MUST implement an explicit published-current-Scope substrate and an explicit reaction-start TheorySnapshot boundary for that slice; host cursors, bank numbers, local handles and storage layout remain substrate details and MUST NOT become semantic authority.

Cross-backend reaction evidence MUST compare normalized portable structural observations of current/successor Scope membership, matched relations and publication handoff, and MUST include negative mismatch/no-match controls; backend-local handles MUST NOT be compared as semantic output.

A backend claiming quiescence MUST expose it as an explicit result of a successful complete reaction evaluation with zero applicable admitted relations; scheduler inactivity, host timeout, empty queues, END topology, malformed state or runtime failure MUST NOT be promoted to semantic quiescence.

A backend claiming ZERO or duplicate-convergence support MUST treat a structurally admitted empty image as a matched relation with zero successor contribution, MUST NOT let ZERO veto sibling non-zero outputs, and MUST converge duplicate successor Links by canonical semantic identity before publication; ZERO-only success is active (non-quiescent) and may publish an empty successor Scope.

A backend claiming P14 support MUST keep live Theory admissions distinct from the reaction-start TheorySnapshot: an admission added after snapshot_t MUST NOT execute in reaction t, and MUST become executable only after an explicit new snapshot at reaction t+1; physical pre-materialization or live storage visibility alone MUST NOT grant same-reaction authority.

A backend claiming P16/P17 support MUST allow bounded observation of active semantic recurrence under an unchanged TheorySnapshot without conflating recurrence with quiescence, and MUST NOT treat structural END as a global halt condition when an admitted continuation relation remains applicable; proof of nontermination MUST use a returning bounded witness rather than an intentionally non-returning runtime.

A backend claiming accepted MTS v0.14 support MUST keep one abstract Link-forming semantic primitive: ROOT/START/END/PAIR recursive self-incidence forms emerge structurally and MUST NOT be implemented or exposed as four semantic opcodes.

Semantic orientation MUST be context-relative and Link-native: START_K/END_K MUST derive from the oriented Context, while technical carrier pole order, host booleans and exact-sequence representations MUST NOT be orientation authority.

The accepted v0.14 reaction-result basis MUST distinguish successful empty result from no admitted relation, MUST treat A->A as active period-1 recurrence rather than quiescence, and MUST preserve distinct A->A♀ and A->♂A outcomes from the same source.
Semantic Links MUST be immutable; execution rewrite/currentness MUST be expressed by structural materialization plus Scope/current-state publication or replacement, never by in-place pole mutation.

The recursive Link codec/wire MUST remain distinct from Anum/ExactSequence sequence representation; compatibility API names containing 'anum' MUST NOT be treated as semantic authority for this equivalence.
Representation, byte/text encoding, runtime locator, packed carrier, proof transport and visualization DTO layers MUST remain non-ontological and MUST NOT create a second semantic entity above Link.

Every accepted MTS v0.14 law V14-L1..V14-L14 MUST have an explicit downstream disposition identifying whether it is implemented at the A-memory boundary, inherited by generic execution-profile behavior, foundation-owned without a separate backend opcode, or explicitly deferred upstream.

acceptance.required: Executable positive and negative witnesses for mandatory A-memory requirements, differential validation of materially different implementations, and explicit V14-L1..V14-L14 downstream disposition. Contract acceptance itself remains a separate governance decision.

coreDefinition.statement: A-memory is a system that stores an A-network of Links and executes its dynamics according to the declared MTS version.
requiredCapabilities: store and preserve the Link network
materialize canonical semantic Links within authorized scope
execute the A-network according to Link-carried MTS semantics
detect or report quiescence where the execution profile requires it
